name: behavioral-firmware-reconstruction
description: Reconstruct an embedded controller's decision logic from observed inputs and outputs without access to the binary firmware. Uses signal correlation, timing analysis, integrity field extraction, and fault condition mapping to build a complete behavioral model.

config.instruction: Parse all bus captures and the signal database. Catalog every message the target controller transmits and receives, with timing profiles and signal ranges.
Reverse engineer the checksum and counter algorithms for all messages identified in the inventory. Test candidate algorithms against the full capture dataset. Accept only 100% match rate.
Reconstruct the controller's state machine from output signal transitions. Map fault conditions from the DTC database to state transitions. Define command acceptance logic per state.
Map the inter-controller communication graph: which controller reads which signals, what it does with the data, and the propagation latency.

Combine the state machine, acceptance logic, integrity algorithms, and routing graph into a unified behavioral model. Validate against held-out data. Score each component by evidence strength. List open questions.
